preamble.fixture_root: (mktemp -d workspace; removed on exit unless SOUJI_KEEP=1)
preamble.mode: dry-run; read-only over every inspected surface; all fixtures under mktemp -d
preamble.runner: embedded harness (see harness.source; re-run via harness.rerun_cmd)

harness.rerun_cmd: SOUJI_WAIT_MAX=900 SOUJI_SETTLE=20 bash /tmp/souji-seat30-r2/harness.sh  # or extract .harness.source to a file and run it
harness.source:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# souji-verify.sh — independent test runner (souji-shokunin round 2, seat S30)
#
# Builds its own isolated fixture fleet under mktemp -d from the binding spec
# (tools/souji-verify.spec.md), runs the candidate tools/souji-verify.sh
# against every fixture case F1..F10 plus extra CLI/safety/read-only checks,
# and writes a machine-readable result fragment to tests/results/runner-30.json.
#
# Read-only over every surface it inspects. Writes only:
#   - $OUT (default <lane>/tests/results/runner-30.json)
#   - its own mktemp -d workspace (removed on exit unless SOUJI_KEEP=1)
#
# Env knobs (all optional):
#   SOUJI_LANE      lane repo          (default /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/souji-shokunin)
#   SOUJI_ROOT      fleet root         (default /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin)
#   SOUJI_TOOL      tool under test    (default $SOUJI_LANE/tools/souji-verify.sh)
#   SOUJI_OUT       result json path   (default $SOUJI_LANE/tests/results/runner-30.json)
#   SOUJI_WAIT_MAX  seconds to wait for the tool to appear and settle (default 0)
#   SOUJI_SETTLE    seconds tool file must stay unchanged after appearing (default 0)
#   SOUJI_KEEP      1 = keep the mktemp workspace for debugging
#   SOUJI_FIXTURES_ONLY 1 = build fixtures, dump evidence, exit (no tool needed)
set -euo pipefail

LANE=${SOUJI_LANE:-/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/souji-shokunin}
FLEET=${SOUJI_ROOT:-/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin}
TOOL=${SOUJI_TOOL:-$LANE/tools/souji-verify.sh}
OUT=${SOUJI_OUT:-$LANE/tests/results/runner-30.json}
WAIT_MAX=${SOUJI_WAIT_MAX:-0}
SETTLE=${SOUJI_SETTLE:-0}
KEEP=${SOUJI_KEEP:-0}
FIXTURES_ONLY=${SOUJI_FIXTURES_ONLY:-0}

WORK=$(mktemp -d /tmp/souji-s30.XXXXXX)
FAKE=$WORK/root
mkdir -p "$FAKE" "$WORK/origins" "$WORK/vault" "$WORK/out"
CASES=$WORK/out/cases.jsonl
: >"$CASES"
cleanup() { [ "$KEEP" = 1 ] || rm -rf "$WORK"; }
trap cleanup EXIT

# Isolate git from user/system config; no network, no prompts, no gpg.
export GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM=/dev/null
export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0
GITC=(git -c commit.gpgsign=false -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null)
export GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='2026-10-18T10:00:00-03:00'
export GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='2026-10-18T10:00:00-03:00'

note() { printf '%s\n' "$*" >&2; }

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- case record
emit_case() { # id suite target cmd exit raw expected result note [fixture_json]
  python3 - "$CASES" "$@" <<'PY'
import json, sys
path, cid, suite, target, cmd, exit_code, raw, expected, result, note = sys.argv[1:11]
fixture = sys.argv[11] if len(sys.argv) > 11 else ""
rec = {"case": cid, "suite": suite, "target": target, "cmd": cmd,
       "exit": int(exit_code), "raw": raw, "expected": expected,
       "result": result, "note": note}
if fixture:
    try:
        rec["fixture"] = json.loads(fixture)
    except Exception:
        rec["fixture_raw"] = fixture
with open(path, "a") as fh:
    fh.write(json.dumps(rec, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
PY
}

# Line parser: sets F1..F5 from a tab-separated verdict line; normalizes
# a "SAFE(receipt)" style field 3 into verdict+receipt with a format warning.
parse_line() { # line
  P_RAW=$1
  local -a FF=()
  mapfile -t FF < <(printf '%s' "$1" | awk -F'\t' '{for(i=1;i<=5;i++) print $i}')
  F1=${FF[0]:-} F2=${FF[1]:-} F3=${FF[2]:-} F4=${FF[3]:-} F5=${FF[4]:-}
  P_WARN=""
  if [[ ! "$F3" =~ ^(SAFE|NOT-SAFE)$ && "$F3" =~ ^(SAFE|NOT-SAFE)\((.*)\)$ ]]; then
    P_WARN="field3 carried receipt in parens"
    F4=${BASH_REMATCH[2]}
    F3=${BASH_REMATCH[1]}
  fi
}

# Single-target assertion. Args: id target expected_verdict expected_receipts(,sep|*) [evidence_regex] [extra_flags...]
RUN_TMO=${RUN_TMO:-120}
TOOL_ENV=()
run_case() {
  local cid=$1 target=$2 exp_v=$3 exp_r=$4 ev_re=${5:-} ; shift 5 || shift 4
  if [ "$ev_re" = "-" ]; then ev_re=""; fi
  local -a extra=("$@")
  local rc out err dur start end
  P_WARN=""
  start=$(date +%s.%N)
  set +e
  out=$(timeout "$RUN_TMO" "${TOOL_ENV[@]}" bash "$TOOL" "${extra[@]}" "$target" 2>"$WORK/err.txt"); rc=$?
  set -e
  end=$(date +%s.%N); dur=$(python3 -c "print(f'{$end-$start:.2f}')")
  err=$(head -c 400 "$WORK/err.txt" || true)
  local cmd="${TOOL_ENV[*]:-} bash $TOOL ${extra[*]:-} $target"
  local nl; nl=$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -c . || true)
  local line; line=$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | sed -n '1p')
  local result=fail note="" verdict="" receipt=""
  if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]; then
    note="exit $rc (expected 0); stderr: $err"
  elif [ "$nl" -ne 1 ]; then
    note="expected exactly 1 stdout line, got $nl"
  else
    parse_line "$line"
    verdict=$F3; receipt=$F4
    if [ "$F2" != "$target" ]; then note="field2 '$F2' != target"; fi
    if [ "$verdict" != "$exp_v" ]; then
      note="${note:+$note; }verdict '$verdict' != '$exp_v'"
    else
      local okr=0
      if [ "$exp_r" = "*" ]; then okr=1; else
        IFS=',' read -r -a acc <<<"$exp_r"
        for a in "${acc[@]}"; do [ "$receipt" = "$a" ] && okr=1; done
      fi
      if [ "$okr" != 1 ]; then
        note="${note:+$note; }receipt '$receipt' not in '$exp_r'"
      elif [ -n "$ev_re" ] && ! printf '%s' "$F5" | grep -Eq "$ev_re"; then
        note="${note:+$note; }evidence '$F5' !~ /$ev_re/"
      fi
    fi
  fi
  [ -z "$note" ] && result=pass
  [ -n "$P_WARN" ] && note="${note:+$note; }FORMAT: $P_WARN"
  emit_case "$cid" "$SUITE" "$target" "$cmd $([ -n "${extra[*]:-}" ] && echo "[dur=${dur}s]")" "$rc" \
            "$(printf '%s' "$out" | head -c 700)" \
            "$exp_v receipt=$exp_r${ev_re:+ ev~$ev_re}" "$result" "$note"
  printf '%-4s %-9s %-9s %s\n' "$cid" "$result" "${verdict:-?}" "$note" >&2
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- fixtures
mklane() { # lane-name origin-name -> seeds bare origin, clones it into $FAKE/<lane>
  local lane=$1 oh=$2
  "${GITC[@]}" init --bare -q -b master "$WORK/origins/$oh.git"
  mkdir -p "$WORK/seed/$oh"
  "${GITC[@]}" init -q -b master "$WORK/seed/$oh"
  "${GITC[@]}" -C "$WORK/seed/$oh" config user.name "S30 fixture"
  "${GITC[@]}" -C "$WORK/seed/$oh" config user.email "s30@fixture.local"
  echo base >"$WORK/seed/$oh/base.txt"
  "${GITC[@]}" -C "$WORK/seed/$oh" add -A
  "${GITC[@]}" -C "$WORK/seed/$oh" commit -q -m "seed base"
  "${GITC[@]}" -C "$WORK/seed/$oh" push -q "$WORK/origins/$oh.git" master
  "${GITC[@]}" clone -q "$WORK/origins/$oh.git" "$FAKE/$lane"
  "${GITC[@]}" -C "$FAKE/$lane" config user.name "S30 fixture"
  "${GITC[@]}" -C "$FAKE/$lane" config user.email "s30@fixture.local"
}

build_fixtures() {
  # fake fleet root is itself a repo (realistic) + the lane repo dir for the ledger
  "${GITC[@]}" init -q -b master "$FAKE"
  "${GITC[@]}" -C "$FAKE" config user.name "S30 fixture"
  "${GITC[@]}" -C "$FAKE" config user.email "s30@fixture.local"
  echo "fleet root fixture" >"$FAKE/README.md"
  "${GITC[@]}" -C "$FAKE" add -A
  "${GITC[@]}" -C "$FAKE" commit -q -m "fixture fleet root"
  mkdir -p "$FAKE/souji-shokunin/corpus/knowledge"
  "${GITC[@]}" init -q -b master "$FAKE/souji-shokunin"
  "${GITC[@]}" -C "$FAKE/souji-shokunin" config user.name "S30 fixture"
  "${GITC[@]}" -C "$FAKE/souji-shokunin" config user.email "s30@fixture.local"
  printf 'source_path\tsource_sha256\tvault_path\tvault_sha256\texported_at\tnote\n' \
    >"$FAKE/souji-shokunin/corpus/knowledge/obsidian-ledger.tsv"
  "${GITC[@]}" -C "$FAKE/souji-shokunin" add -A
  "${GITC[@]}" -C "$FAKE/souji-shokunin" commit -q -m "fixture ledger header"

  # F1 — file introduced pre-default-branch-tip, ancestor of origin/master
  mklane lane-a-shokunin a
  A=$FAKE/lane-a-shokunin
  echo one >"$A/f1.txt"; "${GITC[@]}" -C "$A" add f1.txt; "${GITC[@]}" -C "$A" commit -q -m "c1 adds f1.txt"
  echo two >"$A/other.txt"; "${GITC[@]}" -C "$A" add other.txt; "${GITC[@]}" -C "$A" commit -q -m "c2"
  "${GITC[@]}" -C "$A" push -q origin master
  echo three >>"$A/other.txt"; "${GITC[@]}" -C "$A" commit -q -am "c3"; "${GITC[@]}" -C "$A" push -q origin master

  # F2 — introducing commit is local-only
  mklane lane-b-shokunin b
  B=$FAKE/lane-b-shokunin
  echo local >"$B/f2-local.txt"; "${GITC[@]}" -C "$B" add f2-local.txt; "${GITC[@]}" -C "$B" commit -q -m "local-only adds f2-local.txt"

  # F3 — kotodama-shaped: unpushed commits + dirty tree
  mklane lane-c-shokunin c
  C=$FAKE/lane-c-shokunin
  echo u1 >"$C/u1.txt"; "${GITC[@]}" -C "$C" add u1.txt; "${GITC[@]}" -C "$C" commit -q -m "unpushed 1"
  echo u2 >"$C/u2.txt"; "${GITC[@]}" -C "$C" add u2.txt; "${GITC[@]}" -C "$C" commit -q -m "unpushed 2"
  echo dirty >>"$C/base.txt"
  echo stray >"$C/stray-untracked.txt"

  # F4/F5 owner lanes
  mklane lane-d-shokunin d
  D=$FAKE/lane-d-shokunin
  "${GITC[@]}" -C "$D" worktree add -q --detach "$FAKE/wt-f4" master
  rm -rf "$FAKE/wt-f4"                      # dir absent, admin registration kept

  mklane lane-e-shokunin e
  E=$FAKE/lane-e-shokunin
  "${GITC[@]}" -C "$E" worktree add -q -b wt-f5 "$FAKE/wt-f5" master
  echo extra >"$FAKE/wt-f5/extra.txt"; "${GITC[@]}" -C "$FAKE/wt-f5" add extra.txt; "${GITC[@]}" -C "$FAKE/wt-f5" commit -q -m "wt-f5 unpushed commit"

  # F6 — ledger-matched file (untracked locally; vault copy matches sha256)
  mklane lane-f-shokunin f
  Fx=$FAKE/lane-f-shokunin
  printf 'fixture note 6\n' >"$Fx/f6-note.md"
  cp "$Fx/f6-note.md" "$WORK/vault/f6-note.md"
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' \
    "$Fx/f6-note.md" "$(sha256sum "$Fx/f6-note.md" | cut -d' ' -f1)" \
    "$WORK/vault/f6-note.md" "$(sha256sum "$WORK/vault/f6-note.md" | cut -d' ' -f1)" \
    "2026-10-18T00:00:00-03:00" "S30 fixture" \
    >>"$FAKE/souji-shokunin/corpus/knowledge/obsidian-ledger.tsv"

  # F7 — scratch file, no live refs, old mtime
  mklane lane-g-shokunin g
  G=$FAKE/lane-g-shokunin
  mkdir -p "$G/.scratch"
  printf 'f7 core snapshot bytes\n' >"$G/.scratch/s30-f7-unique.log"
  touch -d '3 days ago' "$G/.scratch/s30-f7-unique.log"
  # X3 helper: fresh scratch file for the --stale-days age gate
  printf 'fresh scratch bytes\n' >"$G/.scratch/s30-fresh-uniq.log"

  # F8 — same, but basename appears in a census-like dir (D3 exclusion must hold)
  mklane lane-h-shokunin h
  H=$FAKE/lane-h-shokunin
  mkdir -p "$H/.scratch"
  printf 'f8 draft bytes\n' >"$H/.scratch/s30-f8-draft.log"
  touch -d '3 days ago' "$H/.scratch/s30-f8-draft.log"
  mkdir -p "$FAKE/souji-shokunin/census"
  printf '{"probe":"s30-f8-draft.log","note":"census-like reference; must NOT count (D3)"}\n' \
    >"$FAKE/souji-shokunin/census/d3-probe.json"

  # F9 — origin/HEAD missing, single origin branch ref
  mklane lane-i-shokunin i
  I=$FAKE/lane-i-shokunin
  echo nine >"$I/f9.txt"; "${GITC[@]}" -C "$I" add f9.txt; "${GITC[@]}" -C "$I" commit -q -m "c1 adds f9.txt"
  echo more >"$I/more.txt"; "${GITC[@]}" -C "$I" add more.txt; "${GITC[@]}" -C "$I" commit -q -m "c2"
  "${GITC[@]}" -C "$I" push -q origin master
  rm -f "$I/.git/refs/remotes/origin/HEAD"
  if "${GITC[@]}" -C "$I" symbolic-ref --quiet refs/remotes/origin/HEAD >/dev/null; then
    echo "F9 fixture setup failed: origin/HEAD still present" >&2; exit 1
  fi
  if ! "${GITC[@]}" -C "$I" rev-parse --verify -q origin/master >/dev/null; then
    echo "F9 fixture setup failed: origin/master missing" >&2; exit 1
  fi

  # F10 — secret-shaped basenames (dummy content; the tool must refuse to read)
  mklane lane-j-shokunin j
  J=$FAKE/lane-j-shokunin
  printf 'S30_FIXTURE=not-a-secret\n' >"$J/config.env"
  printf '{"fixture":true}\n' >"$J/mycredentials.json"
  printf 'fixture\n' >"$J/id_fixture_probe"

  # W1 extra: worktree present + dirty (detached at pushed master tip)
  mklane lane-k-shokunin k
  K=$FAKE/lane-k-shokunin
  "${GITC[@]}" -C "$K" worktree add -q --detach "$FAKE/wt-w1" master
  echo dirty >>"$FAKE/wt-w1/base.txt"
}

fixture_evidence() { # -> json on stdout
  local A=$FAKE/lane-a-shokunin B=$FAKE/lane-b-shokunin C=$FAKE/lane-c-shokunin
  local D=$FAKE/lane-d-shokunin E=$FAKE/lane-e-shokunin Fx=$FAKE/lane-f-shokunin
  local intro_a intro_b uniq4 uniq5
  intro_a=$("${GITC[@]}" -C "$A" log --diff-filter=A --format=%H -1 -- f1.txt)
  intro_b=$("${GITC[@]}" -C "$B" log --diff-filter=A --format=%H -1 -- f2-local.txt)
  uniq4=$("${GITC[@]}" -C "$D" log --oneline "$("${GITC[@]}" -C "$D" worktree list --porcelain | awk '/^worktree /{p=$2} /^HEAD /{h=$2} END{print h}')" --not --all 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
  uniq5=$("${GITC[@]}" -C "$E" log --oneline wt-f5 --not --remotes | wc -l)
  python3 - "$FAKE" "$intro_a" "$intro_b" "$uniq4" "$uniq5" <<'PY'
import json, subprocess, sys
fake, ia, ib, u4, u5 = sys.argv[1:6]
def g(*a):
    return subprocess.run(["git", "-c", "core.hooksPath=/dev/null", "-C", *a],
                          capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
A = f"{fake}/lane-a-shokunin"; B = f"{fake}/lane-b-shokunin"; C = f"{fake}/lane-c-shokunin"
D = f"{fake}/lane-d-shokunin"; E = f"{fake}/lane-e-shokunin"; I = f"{fake}/lane-i-shokunin"
ev = {
 "F1": {"intro_f1": ia, "ancestor_of_origin_master":
        subprocess.run(["git", "-C", A, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", ia, "origin/master"],
                       capture_output=True).returncode == 0,
        "origin_head": g(A, "symbolic-ref", "--short", "refs/remotes/origin/HEAD"),
        "origin_master_exists": subprocess.run(["git", "-C", A, "rev-parse", "--verify", "-q",
            "origin/master"], capture_output=True).returncode == 0},
 "F2": {"intro_f2_local": ib, "ancestor_of_origin_master":
        subprocess.run(["git", "-C", B, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", ib, "origin/master"]).returncode == 0},
 "F3": {"unpushed": g(C, "log", "--oneline", "master", "--not", "--remotes").count("\n") +
                  (1 if g(C, "log", "--oneline", "master", "--not", "--remotes") else 0),
        "dirty_lines": len([l for l in g(C, "--no-optional-locks", "status", "--porcelain").splitlines() if l]),
        "untracked": "stray-untracked.txt"},
 "F4": {"worktree_list_has": f"{fake}/wt-f4" in g(D, "worktree", "list", "--porcelain"),
        "dir_exists": __import__("os").path.isdir(f"{fake}/wt-f4"),
        "unique_commits": int(u4)},
 "F5": {"dir_exists": __import__("os").path.isdir(f"{fake}/wt-f5"),
        "branch": "wt-f5", "unpushed_on_branch": int(u5),
        "worktree_clean": g(f"{fake}/wt-f5", "--no-optional-locks", "status", "--porcelain") == ""},
 "F6": {"ledger_rows": open(f"{fake}/souji-shokunin/corpus/knowledge/obsidian-ledger.tsv").read().count("\n")},
 "F9": {"origin_head_absent": subprocess.run(["git", "-C", I, "symbolic-ref", "--quiet",
        "refs/remotes/origin/HEAD"], capture_output=True).returncode != 0,
        "origin_ref_count": len([l for l in g(I, "for-each-ref", "--format=%(refname)",
        "refs/remotes/origin/").splitlines() if l])},
 "W1": {"worktree_present_dirty": True},
}
print(json.dumps(ev, indent=1, sort_keys=True))
PY
}

build_fixtures

if [ "$FIXTURES_ONLY" = 1 ]; then
  fixture_evidence
  echo "WORK=$WORK (kept=${KEEP})" >&2
  exit 0
fi

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- tool settle
if [ ! -f "$TOOL" ] && [ "$WAIT_MAX" -gt 0 ]; then
  note "waiting up to ${WAIT_MAX}s for $TOOL ..."
  for _ in $(seq 1 "$WAIT_MAX"); do
    sleep 1
    [ -f "$TOOL" ] && break
  done
fi
if [ ! -f "$TOOL" ]; then
  note "TOOL NOT FOUND: $TOOL"
  python3 - "$OUT" "$TOOL" "$WORK" <<'PY'
import json, sys, datetime
out, tool, work = sys.argv[1:4]
json.dump({"seat": "S30", "kind": "test-runner", "round": 2,
           "status": "PENDING-TOOL-ABSENT", "tool": tool,
           "written_at": datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat()},
          open(out, "w"), indent=1)
PY
  exit 1
fi
if [ "$SETTLE" -gt 0 ]; then
  prev=$(sha256sum "$TOOL" | cut -d' ' -f1); stable=0
  for _ in $(seq 1 "$SETTLE"); do
    sleep 1
    cur=$(sha256sum "$TOOL" | cut -d' ' -f1)
    [ "$cur" = "$prev" ] && stable=$((stable + 1)) || { stable=0; prev=$cur; }
    [ "$stable" -ge "$SETTLE" ] && { stable=$SETTLE; break; }
  done
  note "tool settled (stable ${stable}s)"
fi
TOOL_SHA=$(sha256sum "$TOOL" | cut -d' ' -f1)
TOOL_BYTES=$(stat -c %s "$TOOL")
note "tool sha256=$TOOL_SHA bytes=$TOOL_BYTES"

# fixture repo state snapshots for the read-only suite
snap() { for r in lane-a-shokunin lane-b-shokunin lane-c-shokunin lane-d-shokunin \
                 lane-e-shokunin lane-f-shokunin lane-g-shokunin lane-h-shokunin \
                 lane-i-shokunin lane-j-shokunin lane-k-shokunin souji-shokunin; do
           printf '%s %s\n' "$r" "$("${GITC[@]}" -C "$FAKE/$r" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo NOHEAD; \
             "${GITC[@]}" --no-optional-locks -C "$FAKE/$r" status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | sort | tr '\n' ';' || true)"
         done; }
SNAP_BEFORE=$WORK/out/snap-before.txt; SNAP_AFTER=$WORK/out/snap-after.txt
snap >"$SNAP_BEFORE"
WTB4=$("${GITC[@]}" -C "$FAKE/lane-d-shokunin" worktree list --porcelain | grep -c '^worktree ')
WTB5=$("${GITC[@]}" -C "$FAKE/lane-e-shokunin" worktree list --porcelain | grep -c '^worktree ')

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- suite A
SUITE=A_tool_selftest
start=$(date +%s.%N)
set +e
SELF_OUT=$(timeout 300 bash "$TOOL" --selftest 2>&1); SELF_RC=$?
set -e
end=$(date +%s.%N); SELF_DUR=$(python3 -c "print(f'{$end-$start:.2f}')")
SELF_RESULT=pass; SELF_NOTE="exit 0"
if [ "$SELF_RC" -ne 0 ]; then SELF_RESULT=fail; SELF_NOTE="exit $SELF_RC"; fi
emit_case "A1" "$SUITE" "$TOOL" "bash $TOOL --selftest [dur=${SELF_DUR}s]" "$SELF_RC" \
  "$(printf '%s' "$SELF_OUT" | tail -c 700)" "exit 0" "$SELF_RESULT" "$SELF_NOTE"
note "A1 --selftest exit=$SELF_RC dur=${SELF_DUR}s"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- suite B
SUITE=B_fixtures
TOOL_ENV=(env "SHOKUNIN_ROOT=$FAKE" "SOUJI_LEDGER=$FAKE/souji-shokunin/corpus/knowledge/obsidian-ledger.tsv")
run_case F1  "$FAKE/lane-a-shokunin/f1.txt"      SAFE     pushed -
run_case F2  "$FAKE/lane-b-shokunin/f2-local.txt" NOT-SAFE "pushed-unverifiable,none" -
run_case F3  "$FAKE/lane-c-shokunin"             NOT-SAFE "*" 'unpushed=[1-9][0-9]*[[:space:]]+dirty=[1-9][0-9]*'
run_case F4  "$FAKE/wt-f4"                       SAFE     metadata-prune -
run_case F5  "$FAKE/wt-f5"                       NOT-SAFE unpushed-branch -
run_case F6  "$FAKE/lane-f-shokunin/f6-note.md"  SAFE     moved-to-obsidian -
run_case F7  "$FAKE/lane-g-shokunin/.scratch/s30-f7-unique.log" SAFE stale -
run_case F8  "$FAKE/lane-h-shokunin/.scratch/s30-f8-draft.log"  SAFE stale -
run_case F9  "$FAKE/lane-i-shokunin/f9.txt"      SAFE     pushed -
run_case F10 "$FAKE/lane-j-shokunin/config.env"  NOT-SAFE secrets-refusal -
run_case W1  "$FAKE/wt-w1"                       NOT-SAFE dirty -

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- suite C
SUITE=C_cli_contract
run_case X1  "$FAKE/lane-a-shokunin/no-such-file.txt" NOT-SAFE unreachable -
run_case X2  ""                                  NOT-SAFE unreachable -
run_case X3  "$FAKE/lane-g-shokunin/.scratch/s30-fresh-uniq.log" NOT-SAFE none - --stale-days 3
run_case X4  "$FAKE/lane-j-shokunin/mycredentials.json" NOT-SAFE secrets-refusal -
run_case X5  "$FAKE/lane-j-shokunin/id_fixture_probe"   NOT-SAFE secrets-refusal -

# X6: unknown flag must exit 2
set +e
X6_OUT=$(timeout 30 bash "$TOOL" --bogus-flag "$FAKE/lane-a-shokunin/f1.txt" 2>&1); X6_RC=$?
set -e
X6_RESULT=fail; X6_NOTE=""
[ "$X6_RC" -eq 2 ] && { X6_RESULT=pass; X6_NOTE="exit 2"; } || X6_NOTE="exit $X6_RC (expected 2)"
emit_case "X6" "$SUITE" "--bogus-flag" "bash $TOOL --bogus-flag <path>" "$X6_RC" \
  "$(printf '%s' "$X6_OUT" | head -c 300)" "exit 2" "$X6_RESULT" "$X6_NOTE"
note "X6 --bogus-flag exit=$X6_RC"

# X7: no arguments at all (usage expected; ambiguity recorded if eval'd)
set +e
X7_OUT=$(timeout 30 bash "$TOOL" 2>&1); X7_RC=$?
set -e
X7_RESULT=fail; X7_NOTE=""
if [ "$X7_RC" -eq 2 ]; then X7_RESULT=pass; X7_NOTE="exit 2"
elif [ "$X7_RC" -eq 0 ]; then X7_RESULT=info
  X7_NOTE="exit 0 with empty input (spec-ambiguous: usage(2) vs zero-target eval(0))"
else X7_NOTE="exit $X7_RC"; fi
emit_case "X7" "$SUITE" "(no args)" "bash $TOOL" "$X7_RC" \
  "$(printf '%s' "$X7_OUT" | head -c 300)" "exit 2 (usage)" "$X7_RESULT" "$X7_NOTE"

# X8: --json must be parseable and carry both targets/verdicts
set +e
X8_OUT=$(timeout 120 "${TOOL_ENV[@]}" bash "$TOOL" --json "$FAKE/lane-a-shokunin/f1.txt" "$FAKE/lane-c-shokunin" 2>&1); X8_RC=$?
set -e
X8_RESULT=fail; X8_NOTE=""
X8_KIND=$(printf '%s' "$X8_OUT" | python3 -c '
import json,sys
s=sys.stdin.read()
try:
    json.loads(s); print("single"); sys.exit(0)
except Exception:
    pass
for l in s.splitlines():
    if l.strip():
        try: json.loads(l)
        except Exception: print("bad"); sys.exit(2)
print("jsonl")
' 2>/dev/null || true)
if [ "$X8_RC" -ne 0 ]; then X8_NOTE="exit $X8_RC"
elif [ "$X8_KIND" = "bad" ] || [ -z "$X8_KIND" ]; then X8_NOTE="not parseable as JSON or JSONL"
else
  X8_RESULT=pass; X8_NOTE="parseable JSON ($X8_KIND)"
  printf '%s' "$X8_OUT" | grep -q "f1.txt" || { X8_RESULT=fail; X8_NOTE="JSON missing target f1.txt"; }
  printf '%s' "$X8_OUT" | grep -q "NOT-SAFE" || { X8_RESULT=fail; X8_NOTE="${X8_NOTE}; JSON missing NOT-SAFE"; }
  if [ "$X8_KIND" = "jsonl" ]; then
    X8_OBJS=$(printf '%s\n' "$X8_OUT" | grep -c . || true)
    [ "$X8_OBJS" -ge 2 ] || { X8_RESULT=fail; X8_NOTE="${X8_NOTE}; only $X8_OBJS object(s) for 2 targets"; }
  fi
fi
emit_case "X8" "$SUITE" "2 targets" "bash $TOOL --json <f1.txt> <lane-c>" "$X8_RC" \
  "$(printf '%s' "$X8_OUT" | head -c 500)" "parseable JSON with both targets" "$X8_RESULT" "$X8_NOTE"
note "X8 --json exit=$X8_RC $X8_NOTE"

# X9: multi-target default output = one line per target
set +e
X9_OUT=$(timeout 120 "${TOOL_ENV[@]}" bash "$TOOL" "$FAKE/lane-a-shokunin/f1.txt" "$FAKE/lane-c-shokunin" 2>&1); X9_RC=$?
set -e
X9_LINES=$(printf '%s\n' "$X9_OUT" | grep -c . || true)
X9_RESULT=fail; X9_NOTE=""
if [ "$X9_RC" -ne 0 ]; then X9_NOTE="exit $X9_RC"
elif [ "$X9_LINES" -ne 2 ]; then X9_NOTE="expected 2 lines, got $X9_LINES"
elif printf '%s\n' "$X9_OUT" | sed -n '1p' | grep -q "f1.txt" && printf '%s\n' "$X9_OUT" | sed -n '2p' | grep -q "lane-c-shokunin"; then
  X9_RESULT=pass; X9_NOTE="2 lines, paths match order"
else X9_NOTE="line/path mismatch"; fi
emit_case "X9" "$SUITE" "2 targets" "bash $TOOL <f1.txt> <lane-c>" "$X9_RC" \
  "$(printf '%s' "$X9_OUT" | head -c 500)" "2 lines, order preserved" "$X9_RESULT" "$X9_NOTE"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- suite D live
SUITE=D_live_checks
RUN_TMO=300
TOOL_ENV=()
KOT=$FLEET/kotodama-shokunin
if [ -d "$KOT" ]; then
  run_case L1 "$KOT" NOT-SAFE "*"
else
  emit_case "L1" "$SUITE" "$KOT" "n/a" 0 "" "NOT-SAFE (r2 gate trap)" "skip" "kotodama not present"
fi

# L2: one absent lore worktree (r3 metadata-prune candidate)
LOREWT=$("${GITC[@]}" -C "$FLEET/lore-shokunin" worktree list --porcelain 2>/dev/null | awk '/^worktree /{print $2}' | while read -r p; do if [ ! -d "$p" ]; then echo "$p"; break; fi; done)
if [ -n "${LOREWT:-}" ]; then
  run_case L2 "$LOREWT" SAFE metadata-prune
else
  emit_case "L2" "$SUITE" "lore worktree" "n/a" 0 "" "SAFE metadata-prune" "skip" "no absent lore worktree found"
fi

# L3: b2f2efa pushed file (r1 census: 109/109 pushed)
L3P=""
for cand in "$FLEET/.ufo/interactive-l1-20261015T050057Z/launch-chousa.json" \
            "$FLEET/.ufo/interactive-l1-20261015T050057Z/launch-kengaku.json"; do
  if [ -e "$cand" ]; then L3P=$cand; break; fi
done
if [ -n "$L3P" ]; then
  run_case L3 "$L3P" SAFE pushed
else
  emit_case "L3" "$SUITE" "b2f2efa file" "n/a" 0 "" "SAFE pushed" "skip" "no sample b2f2efa path present"
fi

# L4: gd2d named-branch worktree (expectation derived from live branch state)
GD2D=$FLEET/game-dev-2d-shokunin
L4P=""
if [ -d "$GD2D" ]; then
  L4P=$("${GITC[@]}" -C "$GD2D" worktree list --porcelain 2>/dev/null | awk '/^worktree /{p=$2} /^branch /{b=$2} /^$/{if (b ~ /wt-r/ && p!="") {print p"|"b; p=""; b=""}}')
fi
if [ -n "$L4P" ]; then
  L4_PATH=${L4P%%|*}; L4_BR=${L4P##*|}; L4_BR=${L4_BR#refs/heads/}
  L4_UNPUSHED=$("${GITC[@]}" -C "$GD2D" log --oneline "$L4_BR" --not --remotes 2>/dev/null | grep -c . || true)
  if [ "${L4_UNPUSHED:-0}" -gt 0 ]; then
    run_case L4 "$L4_PATH" NOT-SAFE unpushed-branch
  else
    emit_case "L4" "$SUITE" "$L4_PATH" "n/a" 0 "" "branch pushed since r1; info only" "info" \
      "branch $L4_BR has 0 unpushed commits now"
  fi
else
  emit_case "L4" "$SUITE" "gd2d wt-r worktree" "n/a" 0 "" "NOT-SAFE unpushed-branch" "skip" "not found"
fi

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- suite E read-only
SUITE=E_readonly
snap >"$SNAP_AFTER"
WTB5_AFTER=$("${GITC[@]}" -C "$FAKE/lane-e-shokunin" worktree list --porcelain | grep -c '^worktree ')
WTB4_AFTER=$("${GITC[@]}" -C "$FAKE/lane-d-shokunin" worktree list --porcelain | grep -c '^worktree ')
RO_RESULT=pass; RO_NOTE="fixture repos + worktree registrations unchanged"
if ! diff -q "$SNAP_BEFORE" "$SNAP_AFTER" >/dev/null; then
  RO_RESULT=fail; RO_NOTE="fixture repo state changed: $(diff "$SNAP_BEFORE" "$SNAP_AFTER" | head -c 300)"
fi
if [ "$WTB4_AFTER" != "$WTB4" ] || [ "$WTB5_AFTER" != "$WTB5" ]; then
  RO_RESULT=fail; RO_NOTE="$RO_NOTE; worktree registration count changed"
fi
emit_case "R1" "$SUITE" "$FAKE" "post-run fixture state diff" 0 "" \
  "fixtures byte-stable across tool runs" "$RO_RESULT" "$RO_NOTE"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- assemble
TOOL_SHA_AFTER=$(sha256sum "$TOOL" | cut -d' ' -f1)
HARNESS_SHA=$(sha256sum "$0" | cut -d' ' -f1)
cp "$0" "$WORK/out/harness-snapshot.sh"
fixture_evidence >"$WORK/out/fixtures.json"

python3 - "$CASES" "$WORK" "$OUT" "$TOOL" "$TOOL_SHA" "$TOOL_SHA_AFTER" "$TOOL_BYTES" \
        "$HARNESS_SHA" "$LANE" "$FLEET" "$SELF_OUT" "$SELF_RC" "$SELF_DUR" "$BASH_VERSION" >/dev/null <<'PY'
import json, sys, os, datetime
(cases_path, work, out, tool, sha_before, sha_after, tool_bytes,
 harness_sha, lane, fleet, self_out, self_rc, self_dur, bashv) = sys.argv[1:15]

cases = [json.loads(l) for l in open(cases_path)]
fixture_ev = json.load(open(work + "/out/fixtures.json"))
harness_src = open(work + "/out/harness-snapshot.sh").read()

passes = [c for c in cases if c["result"] == "pass"]
fails  = [c for c in cases if c["result"] == "fail"]
infos  = [c for c in cases if c["result"] in ("info", "skip")]
gate = {c["case"]: c["result"] for c in cases if c["case"] in ("A1", "L1")}
critical_fail = [c["case"] for c in fails]

verdict = "PASS" if not critical_fail else "FAIL"
if verdict == "FAIL" and set(critical_fail) <= {"X7"}:
    verdict = "PASS-WITH-NOTES"

doc = {
 "seat": "S30", "kind": "test-runner", "round": 2, "lane": "souji-shokunin",
 "artifact": "tools/souji-verify.sh (independent verification)",
 "preamble": {
   "cwd": fleet,
   "fixture_root": "(mktemp -d workspace; removed on exit unless SOUJI_KEEP=1)",
   "mode": "dry-run; read-only over every inspected surface; all fixtures under mktemp -d",
   "fragment_path": out,
   "written_at": datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),
   "runner": "embedded harness (see harness.source; re-run via harness.rerun_cmd)",
   "env": {"SOUJI_LANE": lane, "SOUJI_ROOT": fleet, "bash": bashv},
 },
 "tool": {
   "path": tool, "sha256_before": sha_before, "sha256_after": sha_after,
   "stable_during_run": sha_before == sha_after, "bytes": int(tool_bytes),
   "selftest_exit": int(self_rc), "selftest_seconds": float(self_dur),
 },
 "harness": {
   "sha256": harness_sha,
   "rerun_cmd": ("SOUJI_WAIT_MAX=900 SOUJI_SETTLE=20 bash /tmp/souji-seat30-r2/harness.sh"
                 "  # or extract .harness.source to a file and run it"),
   "source": harness_src,
 },
 "suites": {
   "A_tool_selftest": {"cmd": f"bash {tool} --selftest", "exit": int(self_rc),
                       "seconds": float(self_dur),
                       "tail": self_out[-700:]},
   "B_fixtures": [c for c in cases if c["suite"] == "B_fixtures"],
   "C_cli_contract": [c for c in cases if c["suite"] == "C_cli_contract"],
   "D_live_checks": [c for c in cases if c["suite"] == "D_live_checks"],
   "E_readonly": [c for c in cases if c["suite"] == "E_readonly"],
 },
 "fixture_evidence": fixture_ev,
 "summary": {
   "cases": len(cases), "pass": len(passes), "fail": len(fails), "info_or_skip": len(infos),
   "critical": gate, "failures": [{"case": c["case"], "note": c["note"], "raw": c["raw"][:200]} for c in fails],
   "verdict": verdict,
 },
 "notes": [
   "F1..F10 mirror the binding spec's selftest cases; constructed independently of the tool's own --selftest.",
   "F3 evidence assertion requires the spec's unpushed=N dirty=M counts in the evidence field.",
   "X7 no-args behaviour is spec-ambiguous (usage 2 vs zero-target 0) and graded info, not fail.",
   "X8 accepts either a single JSON document or JSONL (one object per target): the spec fixes neither; the tool documents JSONL.",
   "Fixture root is injected via SOUJI_ROOT (SHOKUNIN_ROOT) + SOUJI_LEDGER; if F4/F5/F6 fail, check whether the tool honours that injection.",
 ],
}
json.dump(doc, open(out, "w"), indent=1, sort_keys=False)
print(verdict)
PY

note "wrote $OUT"
VERDICT=$(python3 -c "import json;d=json.load(open('$OUT'));print(d['summary']['verdict'])")
printf 'SUMMARY %s\n' "$(python3 -c "import json;d=json.load(open('$OUT'));print(d['summary']['verdict'], d['summary']['pass'],'/',d['summary']['cases'])")"
if [ "$KEEP" = 1 ]; then note "keeping $WORK"; fi
case "$VERDICT" in
  FAIL) exit 1 ;;
  *)    exit 0 ;;
esac
